name: cavemio-json-inspector
title: JSON inspector
description: Read, search and quote a webhook payload or an API response, or see exactly what changed between two versions of a record.

cavemio.accessibility:
- A real tree for assistive tech: treeitems with level, position and expanded state, one tab stop. ↑ and ↓ move, → opens or steps in, ← closes or steps out, Home and End jump, Enter or Space toggles, / jumps to search, and ⌘C or Ctrl+C copies the value of the row you're on.
- Each row has a spoken label (key, value, and in a diff "added", "removed" or "was …"); match counts and copies are announced in a status region.
- Containers with more than 100 children show them a hundred at a time with "Show 100 more · 1,240 left"; a search reaches past that to show a match.
- json-tree.ts has no React in it: buildTree, diffTree, formatPath, searchTree and parseError work on a server too, e.g. to store the diff of an audit event.
- Strings, numbers and booleans use the same light and dark palette as Code block; diff marks use emerald, red and amber with a sign beside each, so colour is never the only signal.
- Reduced motion: folds, the chevron and the path change in place.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: data
props.description: – · A value to show. Circular references show as "[circular]".

props.name: text
props.description: – · JSON text instead of a value; if it doesn't parse, the error is shown with the line and column.

props.name: compare
props.description: – · The value before. With it, the inspector shows how compare became data.

props.name: arrayKey
props.description: – · In a diff, match array items by this key ("id") instead of by position.

props.name: expandDepth
props.description: 2 · Levels open at first (in a diff, everything with changes opens instead).

props.name: title
props.description: – · Shown at the top left, e.g. the event name and status.

props.name: defaultQuery
props.description: – · Start with this search, e.g. from a "find in payload" link.

props.name: pathStyle
props.description: "js" · How paths are written: data.items[0].id, or .data.items[0].id for jq.

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: 360 · Height of the scrolling body in px.

useCases.title: Webhook deliveries
useCases.description: Show the payload your endpoint received, and exactly where a broken one broke.

useCases.title: API explorers
useCases.description: Let developers read responses in your dashboard or docs and copy what they need.

useCases.title: Audit logs
useCases.description: Show which fields changed between two versions of a record, and nothing else.

useCases.title: AI tool calls
useCases.description: Inspect the arguments and results of tool calls without scrolling a wall of text.

features.title: Folds and previews
features.description: Objects and arrays open and close; closed ones show what’s inside, like { id, amount, … } or 12 items.

features.title: Searches keys and values
features.description: The branches above every match open, and Enter steps from one match to the next.

features.title: Copies the path
features.description: The row you’re on is written out, as data.items[0].id or in jq style, with Copy path and Copy value beside it.

features.title: Reads timestamps
features.description: ISO dates and Unix times under keys like created_at say when they are.

features.title: Diffs two versions
features.description: Added, removed and changed keys are marked, arrays are matched by id, and unchanged keys fold away.

features.title: Explains broken JSON
features.description: It points at the line and column where parsing stopped, with the lines around it.

states.title: fold
states.description: A container opens and closes by height (grid rows, 280ms) while its chevron turns 90°. Children stay mounted once shown, so closing animates as well as opening. Closed containers preview their first three keys or their item count.

states.title: focus
states.description: The row you're on (clicked or reached with the arrows) takes the accent fill, shows its whole string instead of a truncated one, and adds a readable date beside ISO strings and Unix timestamps under keys like created or period_end.

states.title: path
states.description: The footer writes the path of that row and morphs it letter by letter as you move (360ms), so the shared prefix stays put. Copy path and Copy value are Status buttons: the label becomes Copied and a check draws itself.

states.title: search
states.description: Matches are marked in keys and values 120ms after typing stops. Branches above every match open; the "3/12" count opens in beside the field and rolls; Enter, ↓ or the arrows step to the next match, which is outlined and scrolled to a third of the way down.

states.title: diff
states.description: With compare, each row is same, added (+, emerald tint), removed (−, red tint, struck) or changed (~, old value struck beside the new). Containers with changes open; closed ones show their counts. Unchanged keys fold into a "12 unchanged" row until you ask for them or a search finds one.

states.title: broken
states.description: Text that doesn't parse shows the reason, the line and column, and the lines around it with a caret under the exact character, found by its own scanner because browsers report positions differently.
